snippet.title: Smashometry - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Smashometry is a pure arcade reflex test - fast, chaotic, and relentlessly addictive. Read the screen, react in milliseconds, and rack up massive scores in this deceptively simple, skill-driven challenge.
